name: Minimal Monochrome
keywords: minimal, monochrome, black and white, clean, single color
description: Near-one-hue palette using a single accent against grayscale surfaces; maximum restraint.
usage_or_notes: SaaS, dev tools, portfolio sites. Keep 1 accent, 5 gray steps; test contrast at every step.

name: Neo-Brutalism
keywords: brutalism, bold borders, hard shadows, raw, high contrast, playful
description: Hard edges, thick 2-4px borders, offset solid shadows, saturated blocks and visible grids.
usage_or_notes: Gen-Z products, indie tools, event pages. Avoid for dense dashboards; shadows 4px 4px 0.

name: Glassmorphism
keywords: glass, blur, frosted, translucent, backdrop, glow
description: Frosted translucent surfaces over colorful blurred backdrops with subtle 1px white borders.
usage_or_notes: Hero sections, media apps. Requires backdrop-filter support; keep opacity 0.5-0.8 for legibility.

name: Dark Mode OLED
keywords: dark, oled, night, black, low light, true black
description: True-black backgrounds with desaturated primary text and vivid accent highlighting.
usage_or_notes: Developer tools, media players. Provide light theme toggle; avoid pure #000 mid-gray walls.

name: Corporate Trust Blue
keywords: corporate, trust, blue, finance, enterprise, professional
description: Navy and steel-blue palette with white space and conservative typography for credibility.
usage_or_notes: Fintech, enterprise, legal, healthcare. Pair with serif display face; reserve red for errors only.

name: Warm Editorial
keywords: editorial, warm, cream, serif, magazine, lifestyle
description: Cream backgrounds, warm neutrals, oversized serif headlines like a print magazine.
usage_or_notes: Lifestyle brands, blogs, fashion. Use 16px+ body, generous 8:1 type scale.

name: Y2K Cyber
keywords: y2k, cyber, futuristic, chrome, neon, retro-futura
description: Chrome gradients, neon accents on dark, grid overlays and dot-matrix type.
usage_or_notes: Music, gaming, streetwear drops. Very expressive; cap at 2 neon hues + chrome.

name: Soft Pastel UI
keywords: pastel, soft, rounded, friendly, clouds, candy
description: Low-saturation pastel washes, 16-24px radii, soft drop shadows, friendly microcopy.
usage_or_notes: Kids products, wellness, productivity apps. Text must stay dark gray for AA contrast.

name: Swiss Grid
keywords: swiss, international, grid, helvetica, rational, typographic
description: Strict modular grid, Helvetica-style grotesk, asymmetric layout, no decoration.
usage_or_notes: Documentation, studios, analytics landing. Snap everything to a 12-col grid, 8px baseline.

name: Handdrawn Sketch
keywords: sketch, handdrawn, playful, rough, wireframe-style, casual
description: Sketchy borders, wobbly underlines, hand-style annotations on a notebook-style canvas.
usage_or_notes: Indie tools, onboarding wizards. Use sparingly; body text stays a clean sans.

name: Luxury Dark Gold
keywords: luxury, dark, gold, serif, premium, champagne
description: Charcoal surfaces, thin gold accents, refined serif display, roomy letter-spacing.
usage_or_notes: High-end commerce, hotels, watches. Gold <=10% of pixels; mat:gold 20% fails.

name: Accessible High Contrast
keywords: accessible, high contrast, wcag, bold, inclusive
description: WCAG-first system: >=7:1 body contrast, visible focus rings, large tap targets.
usage_or_notes: Healthcare, government, accessibility-first launches. Verify with automated checks + manual.

name: Material Expressive
keywords: material, expressive, container, elevated, dynamic color
description: Material 3 expressive shapes, tonal containers, dynamic accent adjustments.
usage_or_notes: Android-adjacent or cross-platform web apps. Use tonal container pairs for cards.

name: Neumorphism Soft
keywords: neumorphism, soft ui, embossed, debossed, monochrome shape
description: Same-background extruded shapes with dual light/dark shadows; subtle skeuomorphism.
usage_or_notes: Settings panels, music controllers. Poor accessibility; never for text surfaces.
